goal.title: Apply fictional exhibit scheduling rules to concrete cases
goal.learningTarget: Determine valid exhibit room reservations from stated opening times, duration limits, and precedence rules
goal.questionDirective: Write five distinct, self-contained applications of fictional exhibit-room scheduling rules. State every rule, time convention, and needed fact inside each item; use exact times and avoid outside museum knowledge. Include plausible distractors based on a single mistaken rule. Do not reuse a scenario or correct-answer mechanism.

goal.title: Evaluate one exact rational expression
goal.learningTarget: Evaluate a fully specified fraction expression with exact rational arithmetic and operation precedence
goal.questionDirective: Create exactly one typed quantitative exact_value task for the expression (3/4 + 5/6) / 2. Encode the given operands and operations in the flat node graph with an exact unitless result and four distinct rational answer choices. Use no word story, outside facts, or rounding.

goal.title: Build exact quantitative practice from elementary expressions
goal.learningTarget: Solve self-contained arithmetic and comparison tasks with exact answers
goal.questionDirective: Create five distinct, self-contained quantitative tasks supported by the structured arithmetic grammar. State exact operands, units when used, and answer domains. Vary operations and distractor mechanisms; avoid equivalent filler tasks and any unstated real-world assumption.
